data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 私密床榻的彻底沦陷温存
data.description: 总统套房主卧奢华松软的丝绸大床上，黑金丝绸睡袍带子已完全解开，雪白紧致的肌肤与动人曲线一览无余。晴奈侧卧在微乱的床褥中，黑发与朱红挑染交织散落在羽绒枕间。她双眸满溢着无以复加的痴迷与温顺依赖，彻底交托出全部的骄傲与身心。
data.location: luxury penthouse master suite king bed
data.action: reclining on silk bed, silk robe loose, flushed sensuality, devoted submissive gaze
data.lighting: romantic dim golden bedside lamps casting soft seductive silhouettes
data.mood: absolute passionate surrender, deep intoxicating romance, and sensual devotion
data.promptProse: Reclining on a lavish silk master bed with her black robe loosened, Kurodate Haruna gazes up with melting crimson eyes and breathless devotion in warm seductive lamplight.
data.animaCaption: Haruna reclining on a plush bed in a silk robe with breathtaking flushed devotion.
